problem.h: Your Kindle case says nothing about you
p: You’ve read the whole series twice, you’ve got opinions about the bat boys, and your e-reader is still plain black.
Most bookish stickers are a bit sweet for what you actually read.
Skulls, roses, poison bottles, tarot cards and a good dose of humour. These stickers are for the readers who stay up far too late with a morally grey love interest.
Stick them on your Kindle, your reading journal or the box you keep your special editions in.

faq: Will they fit on a Kindle?
Yes, they’re sized for e-readers, Kindle cases, phone cases and journals. Stick them on the case rather than the screen.
Some designs have grown-up humour, such as “Proud smut reader”, so they’re best for adult readers.
There’s a big mix of designs. You can see them all in the full pack photo above.
Would they make a good gift?
For a romantasy fan, absolutely. They’re a great stocking filler or book club gift.
What if I’m not happy with them?
You buy through Amazon, so Amazon’s usual returns process applies. You can also email me at hello@mazomoon.com and I’ll do what I can to help.
